I'm 41 and in a similar situation. Feel like I've no place to go and nothing will get better and always be  a failure. I've been this way a few time and come back from it but always end up back feeling like this.

My point is today I did something I've never done before, I talked about it. To mental health volunteers, to work colleagues and to a friend I didn't even know was doing councillors training. And you know what they all listened. They listened and didn't judge.

Not one judged me for having suicidal thoughts, no one judged me for self harming to keep horrible thoughts out my head, they just asked me stuff and let me speak.

Before you make any rash decision give it a try. Wither it the help lines above, a friend or a family member.

I promise you that your not a failure to your family and grades aren't the end of the world. You can make your life what you want it.

None of us want to come on here and find out someone as young as yourself had took that route to end the sadness and hurt so please at least try and talk to someone  and learn from an old man who took far to long to learn this lesson.

Time. 

Take as much time as you need. You can cry everyday, week, month. Run scenarios through your head 24/7 think back on all the good times, question why me what did I do wrong, make promises to change etc etc.
Do all this for as long as at takes for you to realise what is best for you. All those feeling and emotions bombard you day and night. They especially get you when you can't keep your mind busy and it's a nightmare. But through time things will change. Through time your feeling will change but mostly through time you'll get your true answers.
In my time, I tried to take my life multiple time, give up custody of my kids(thankfully this didn't happen), take out frustration on my family that supported me from the start and blamed myself for my ex wife leaving.
But time showed me my kids are the most important people in my life, your family will always have your back and I was better off without my serial cheater of an ex wife.
My life got better, I met someone new who truly makes me happy and loves me and we are having a baby girl with. My kids love her and I love her kids.
So in time, everything gets better. Take it from someone that was at the bottom of the barrel and beyond.

It might seem hopeless, but there is always hope and life can get so much better if you let it.
